s0.text: ThinkLatent Portal · Interface v5.1 · 2026-11-05 · v5 plus the gap backlog built: 114 gaps and 11 fixes, defaults A1–A12 recorded in the requirements doc. Built on thinklatent-labs/design-kit (colour system v1.1: Brand Green brand, Sea Teal companion, Decision Red as the decision colour; off-white light, black dark). Shell D with the v5.1 dock (Home, Ask ThinkLatent, Models, Projects, Training, Data, Evaluation, Agents, Approvals, Inbox, Help) and an Engineering view switch. Rules: status is glyph plus word; intervals one unit; unmeasured is an em dash with a reason; every number has a source; production request data sealed; agents propose, people decide. Screen ids match section 7 of the requirements doc; sub-pages of a screen stack beneath it.

s_p0.text: v6 batch 1, 7 Nov 2026, for Jithin's review; numbers corrected after an independent audit the same day. The onboarding-to-production journey as ten long pages, left to right: start a project, project home, usage and first call, new training run, runs in flight, checkpoints, evaluation, approval, models and canary, production overview. Decision 16 applied: one ⓘ per table column header and at most 15 a page elsewhere, none in table cells; paired difference decides Better or Tie where runs share items. The 35 v5.1 boards these pages replace stay on the pages that follow until the batch is approved. Next batch after review.
